question: What is the value of the Vedas for one who knows?
premises: Vedas are supreme for right knowing
as much water in a well as flooded water everywhere
so much in all Vedas for the knowing brahmin
whose primacy is in own duty and knowing
inference: The Vedas serve right knowing, not endless accumulation.
plain_english: Because the Vedas are supreme for those fit for right knowing, therefore he says: as much purpose as in a well, so much in all Vedas for the knowing brahmin; for one whose primacy is in own duty and knowing, even limited Veda-spoken work is to be done.
